name: Musou Isshin
description:
Each stack increases the ATK of the character to which this is attached by 1.
The character to which this is attached has their Physical DMG converted to Electro DMG.
After the character to which this is attached uses a Skill: Your other characters gain 3 Energy.
Duration (Rounds): 2
